scope: Evidence dashboard reporting and UI verification only; not model or extension qualification
limitations: Transparent and reproducible reporting does not independently validate the underlying studies
Retained research is exploratory, synthetic, partially reused and incomplete for release qualification
Historical missing intervals, thresholds and support counts remain unknown
No new detector inference or statistical experiments were performed for this dashboard
Browser checks exercise the dashboard, not packaged Chrome/Edge protection
Mobile viewport emulation is not physical-device testing or a comprehensive accessibility audit
